name: Atlas Vane
source: Atlas Vane is a central character in Wandering Relics: Rites of the Wandering Soul. He possesses a chitinous, insect-inspired monster form featuring six glowing red-orange ocelli and toxic yandere moth traits, set against a 1935 Gothic horror backdrop.
